sloka: मन्निमित्तेन मानार्हः कच्चिच्छोकेन राघवः ।कच्चिन्नान्यमना रामः कच्चिन्मां तारयिष्यति ।। ५.३६.२३।।।।
transliteration: mannimittena mānārhaḥ kaccicchokena rāghavaḥ ।kaccinnānyamanā rāmaḥ kaccinmāṁ tārayiṣyati ।। 5.36.23।।।।

translations.english: "I hope respectable Rama is not too absentminded for being immersed in sorrow on my account. Hope he will save me.
